newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Pertamina says Balongan refinery runs at 95 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pertamina says Balongan refinery runs at 95 pct.

text.p: Indonesia's state oil company Pertamina is currently running its Balongan refinery crude distillation unit (CDU) at 95 percent of its capacity of 125,000 barrels a day, a Pertamina source said on Tuesday.
"The crude distillation unit is running at 95 percent of its capacity currently. We will increase it to 100 percent around March 29," the source told Reuters.
"The unit in the refinery is running very well. The residue catalytic cracker (RCC) unit is also working fine," he said.
Pertamina restarted the Balongan refinery CDU on March 15 at 75 percent capacity and the RCC on March 16.
The RCC, which has a 83,000 bpd capacity, had been shut since February.
